name: Covert Retrieval Planning
description: Every device placed inside a target must have a retrieval plan. Unrecovered implants are a serious liability — they can be discovered during security sweeps and create attribution risk. Retrieval plans must be developed before placement and should account for changed access conditions, increased security posture, and time windows where retrieval is feasible. A confederate retrieval option should be considered for high-risk placements.

blue.det: Retrieval attempt may require re-entry — detectable through access logs; operator in restricted area without clear purpose.
blue.cm: Access log monitoring for unusual re-entry patterns; camera coverage of areas where implants were placed; correlate physical access events with network/RF anomalies.
